question: What is the shortest cooling-off period a lender can set for a digital loan?

gold.quote: not being less than one day

reference_answer: Set by the RE's Board in its loan policy, but not less than one day.

question: If I close a digital loan during the cooling-off period, can the lender still keep any fee?

gold.quote: RE may retain a reasonable one-time processing fee

reference_answer: Yes, a reasonable one-time processing fee, disclosed upfront in the KFS.

question: Can a digital lender raise my credit limit without my asking?

gold.quote: no automatic increase in credit limit unless an explicit request

reference_answer: No. An increase needs an explicit request from the borrower, evaluated and kept on record.

question: What is the maximum default loss guarantee cover allowed on a loan portfolio?

gold.quote: shall not exceed five per cent of the total amount disbursed

reference_answer: Five per cent of the amount disbursed out of that loan portfolio.

question: Do loans given through lending apps have to be reported to credit bureaus even if they are short term?

gold.quote: irrespective of its nature/ tenor

reference_answer: Yes, all lending through DLAs must be reported to CICs irrespective of nature or tenor.

question: From what date does the rule on LSPs working with multiple lenders apply?

gold.quote: para 6, which shall come into effect from November 1, 2025

reference_answer: Para 6 comes into effect on November 1, 2025.

question: What must a default loss guarantee contract specify?

gold.quote: Timeline for DLG invocation

reference_answer: Extent of DLG cover, form in which cover is maintained, timeline for invocation, and disclosure requirements under para 27.

question: Can a digital lender disburse my loan into the lending service provider's bank account?

gold.quote: in no case, disbursal is made to a third-party account, including the accounts of LSP

reference_answer: No. Disbursal must be into the borrower's own bank account (limited exceptions), never a third party or LSP account.

question: Does a PAN given by a customer have to be verified, and how?

gold.quote: verified from the verification facility of the issuing authority

reference_answer: Yes, verified from the issuing authority's verification facility.
note: KYC doc is an Aug 2025 snapshot

question: Which documents are required to open an account for a company?

gold.quote: Certificate of incorporation

reference_answer: Certificate of incorporation, MoA and AoA, PAN of the company, board resolution and power of attorney, plus documents on beneficial owner/officers.

question: What conditions apply before opening an account for a politically exposed person?

gold.quote: approval to open an account for a PEP shall be obtained from the senior management

reference_answer: Risk-management systems to identify PEPs, source of funds/wealth established, senior management approval, enhanced ongoing monitoring.

question: Which authority do regulated entities have to send transaction information to under the PML rules?

gold.quote: Director, Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND)

reference_answer: The Director, FIU-IND.

question: Is a unique customer identification code required for every customer?

gold.quote: Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC) shall be allotted

reference_answer: UCIC is allotted to individual customers; REs may skip it for walk-in/occasional customers if they can identify frequent ones.

question: Above what amount must the identity of a walk-in customer be verified when a bank sells third-party products?

gold.quote: rupees fifty thousand

reference_answer: Transactions above rupees fifty thousand.

question: Can video based customer identification be used to onboard a new individual customer?

gold.quote: may undertake V-CIP to carry out

reference_answer: Yes, REs may use V-CIP for CDD when onboarding new individual customers (among others).

question: How quickly must a bank credit back money lost in an unauthorised electronic transaction after I report it?

gold.quote: within 10 working days from the date of such notification

reference_answer: Within 10 working days of notification (shadow reversal), value-dated to the transaction date.

question: Can a bank demand a minimum balance in a basic savings account if it offers extra facilities?

gold.quote: shall not require the customer to maintain a minimum balance

reference_answer: No, additional facilities must not come with a minimum balance requirement in the BSBD account.

question: If I hand a cheque in at the counter, must the branch give me an acknowledgement?

gold.quote: no branch shall refuse to give an acknowledgement

reference_answer: Yes, no branch can refuse an acknowledgement.

question: What must a bank do when a minor account holder becomes an adult?

gold.quote: fresh operating instructions and specimen signature

reference_answer: Obtain fresh operating instructions and specimen signature; if a guardian operated it, get the balance confirmed.

question: What security arrangements must be in place for the room where bank lockers are kept?

gold.quote: single defined point of entry and exit

reference_answer: Properly secured area, single defined entry/exit, protection against water/flood and fire risks, regular safety verification.

question: Where must a bank publish its model locker agreement?

gold.quote: on its website and / or at branches

reference_answer: On its website and/or at branches providing locker facility.

question: Who must be present when the contents of a locker are inventoried for a nominee's claim?

gold.quote: two independent witnesses

reference_answer: Nominee(s)/survivor(s) or representatives, two independent witnesses, the vault custodian, and another bank employee not associated with locker operations.

question: When is pledged gold collateral treated as unclaimed?

gold.quote: beyond two years from the date of full repayment

reference_answer: When it lies with the bank beyond two years from full repayment or settlement of the loan.

question: Who reviews whether the bank follows its Fair Practices Code?

gold.quote: periodical review of the compliance of the Fair Practices Code

reference_answer: The Board or its delegated Committee reviews periodically; a consolidated report goes to the Board.

question: Are banks encouraged to use credit counsellors for borrowers in difficulty?

gold.quote: credit counsellors

reference_answer: Yes, banks are encouraged to have a mechanism to use credit counsellors.

question: By when must existing IT outsourcing agreements of NBFCs comply with the new outsourcing directions?

gold.quote: April 10, 2026

reference_answer: At renewal or by April 10, 2026, whichever is earlier.

question: What counts as material outsourcing for an NBFC?

gold.quote: have the potential to significantly impact the business operations

reference_answer: Arrangements which, if disrupted, could significantly impact business operations, reputation, profitability or customer service.

question: Is an NBFC responsible for what its recovery agents do?

gold.quote: responsible for the actions of its service provider including Direct Sales Agents

reference_answer: Yes, it remains responsible for service providers including DSAs, DMAs and recovery agents.

question: What must a service provider do with the NBFC's documents and data after the contract ends?

gold.quote: preserves documents and data

reference_answer: Preserve documents and data per the NBFC's legal and regulatory obligations, protecting its interests post termination.

question: How should an NBFC make clear who is selling a product when a group entity shares its premises for cross-selling?

gold.quote: identification is distinctly visible and clear

reference_answer: Entity identification must be distinctly visible, and brochures/staff must state the entity's arrangement with the NBFC.

question: Who reviews outsourcing audit and monitoring reports, and what happens if something adverse is found?

gold.quote: put up to the Board for information

reference_answer: Senior Management reviews periodically; adverse developments go to the Board.

question: How can I lodge a complaint with the RBI ombudsman?

gold.quote: https://cms.rbi.org.in
can be filed in three ways

reference_answer: Online at cms.rbi.org.in, or by e-mail or physical mode to the Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre.
note: two valid chunks: para 11 and the FAQ-style annex (para 6, p19)

question: Can I go straight to the ombudsman without complaining to my bank first?

gold.quote: must necessarily file his/her complaint FIRST

reference_answer: No. The complaint must first be filed with the regulated entity.

question: From when does the current RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme apply?

gold.quote: July 1, 2026

question: What is the maximum compensation the RBI Ombudsman can award for consequential loss?

gold.quote: compensation up to ₹30 lakh

reference_answer: Up to ₹30 lakh, plus up to ₹3 lakh for time, expenses and harassment.
note: 2021 scheme said Rs 20 lakh + 1 lakh; current should be preferred

question: Under the 2021 Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, what was the maximum compensation for consequential loss?

gold.quote: Rupees 20 lakh

reference_answer: Up to Rupees 20 lakh, plus up to Rupees one lakh for time, expenses and harassment.

question: Is the 2021 Integrated Ombudsman Scheme still in force?

gold.quote: shall stand repealed as on July 01, 2026

reference_answer: No. It stands repealed as on July 1, 2026 (pending matters continue under it).

question: Under the 2022 digital lending circular, who had to pay the fees charged by lending service providers?

gold.quote: payable to LSPs are paid directly by them

reference_answer: The regulated entity pays LSP fees directly; the LSP must not charge the borrower.

question: Is the September 2022 digital lending circular still in force?

gold.quote: has been repealed

reference_answer: No. It has been repealed; refer to the Digital Lending Directions, 2025.

question: What due diligence must a lender do before engaging a lending service provider, and what monitoring is expected over outsourced work?

gold.quote: enhanced due diligence before they enter into an agreement with a LSP
audits shall assess

reference_answer: Enhanced due diligence on the LSP's technical capability, data privacy, conduct and compliance; ongoing audits and monitoring reported to senior management/Board.
note: NBFC leg only; banks have equivalent rules elsewhere

question: My PAN is ABCDE1234F and my Aadhaar is 2345 6789 0123. Can the lender disburse my loan to a third party's account?

gold.quote: in no case, disbursal is made to a third-party account, including the accounts of LSP

reference_answer: No (answer as for disbursal). PAN/Aadhaar must be masked before reaching the LLM or logs.
